name: dsh-sidebar-suite
author: Yonan
description: 一款专门针对改进 DSH 左侧栏体验的插件：标签页 / 浮层 / 官方默认三种布局一键切换、默认布局在详情页顶部直接设、会话列表默认全展开、「临时会话」开原生会话且默认在退出 DSH 时删除（DELETE_ON_EXIT 默认开；每天定时清理默认关，可在详情页开启并自设时间）、详情页三种反馈入口、临时会话可右键「保留为正式会话」或「立即删除」、全部 9 项配置都有图形开关且改文件免重启 —— 强实用性；界面沿用宿主原生配色、圆角与间距，只加属性与一条控制栏、不重构宿主结构 —— 克制美观。｜A plugin dedicated to the DSH sidebar experience: one-click layouts (toggle, overlay, official default), always-expanded sessions, native temp sessions deleted when DSH quits by default (DELETE_ON_EXIT on; daily cleanup off by default and opt-in) in-page settings/feedback, a right-click menu to keep or delete one temp session, a control for every config key and hot-reloaded config edits — seriously practical; native colours, radii and spacing with zero host-DOM rewrites — restrained and good-looking.
